claim.claim-text: 1. A method for an electronic device to receive a fingerprint data, the electronic device comprising a touch unit (220) comprising a plurality of touch pixels (222), a display unit (230) comprising a plurality of display pixels (232) and a sensing unit (240) comprising a plurality of sensing pixels (242), the method comprising:

2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the density of a part of the plurality of touch pixels (222) in the finger touch region (20) is less than a density of a part of the plurality of display pixels (232) in the first region (30).
3. The method according to claim 1, wherein the display unit (230) is disposed between the sensing unit (240) and the touch unit (220).
4. The method according to claim 1, further comprising: showing a fingerprint authentication region (70), wherein the fingerprint authentication region corresponds to the first region (30).
5. The method according to claim 4, wherein the fingerprint authentication region (70) is greater than the finger touch region (20).
6. The method according to claim 1, wherein an area of the sensing region (40) is greater than or equal to an area of the finger touch region (20).
7. The method according to claim 1, further comprising: turning on at least one of the red pixels or the green pixels in the first region.

8. The method according to claim 1, wherein the electronic device further comprises a cover layer (260) disposed on the touch unit (220), wherein the touch unit is disposed between the cover layer (260) and the display unit (230).
9. An electronic device, characterized in that comprising:
10. The electronic device according to claim 9, wherein the display unit (230) has a first region (30) overlapped with the finger touch region (20).

11. The electronic device according to claim 10, wherein the density of a part of the plurality of touch pixels (222) in the finger touch region (20) is less than a density of a part of the plurality of display pixels (232) in the first region (30).
